articles.summary: Flu season is arriving early this year, which could spell trouble for hospital capacity in the province.

articles.title: North Atlantic right whales no match for vessel strikes, entanglements between Canada and U.S.
articles.summary: With the latest estimates putting the North Atlantic right whale population at just 382, a consortium is calling for urgent action to safeguard the species' survival.

articles.title: CBSA demoting border officers who permanently lost ability to use sidearm
articles.summary: The Canada Border Services Agency has informed 63 employees that they will have to take on new, lower-paid positions because of medical conditions that prevent them from carrying a sidearm.
